release_notes: AutoPilot AI works again. In 1.0.6 adding your own Anthropic key produced an error instead of an answer, because of a dependency that changed underneath us; the version is now pinned so it cannot happen again. If you tried the AI in 1.0.6 and it failed, it will work now with the same key. AutoPilot AI conversations are no longer written to the app's local log file on your PC. Macros no longer stop early without telling you. Before, if any single step could not be carried out, the rest of the macro was abandoned and all you saw was that it had done one or two things - which looked like the macro was broken. It now tells you which step stopped it, how many steps did not run, and why it stopped rather than carrying on. A macro that cannot be completed can also no longer be saved: the step is flagged while you are still editing it. If a macro tries to open an application and the application does not start, the macro now stops there instead of continuing - the typing and clicking that followed would have gone to whichever window happened to be open. Macros started by a hotkey or at startup now tell you when they stop early, and the notification reports the real number of steps instead of always saying zero. Cleanup is more careful about what it promises: where it can check, it now counts only space it has confirmed it can actually free, so the figure may be slightly smaller and closer to what you get. The duplicate finder now says which folders it looked in, and explains that it only matches identical copies - two versions of the same song or photo saved at a different quality are different files. Fixed the About section of Settings, where the buttons could be drawn over the heading. Includes all v1.0.6 fixes.
